fields.name: builtAs
fields.tooltip: SpeedOrb = a tier of the spawn set's speed orbs (below). RepairOrb = the repair orb. Pickup = a new power-up built from the pad below.

fields.name: speedOrbTier
fields.tooltip: SpeedOrb only: the tier (0 Green, 1 Blue, 2 Purple in the shipped set).

fields.name: pad
fields.tooltip: Pickup only: the power-up — prefab, definition (what it does), boost multiplier, colour, sway, lane.

fields.name: color
fields.tooltip: The palette's and the gizmo's colour.

fields.name: prefab
fields.tooltip: Optional model spawned instead of the code-built primitive. Colliders are forced to triggers; one is added if the prefab has none.

fields.name: definition
fields.tooltip: What the pad does on pickup (boost/brake, orb or flat pad, size).

fields.name: probability
fields.tooltip: Share of every spawn roll this entry wins. The tiers always sum to 100%. Unused by a single-entry spawner.

fields.name: multiplier
fields.tooltip: Boosts only: multiplies GameSettings.powerUpSpeedBoost. Brakes use their definition's own delta.

fields.name: color
fields.tooltip: Tint of the code-built primitive (prefabs keep their own materials) and of the pickup's story color.

fields.name: swayAmplitude
fields.tooltip: How far the orb sways side to side across the track, in meters. 0 = holds the flight line.

fields.name: spinDegreesPerSecond
fields.tooltip: Floating orbs only: how fast the orb turns about the track's up, degrees per second. 0 = holds the prefab's authored rotation (a model tilted inside its prefab wobbles when spun).

fields.name: pickupScale
fields.tooltip: Scales the pickup volume (the prefab's colliders and the analytic box) without touching the picture. 2 = twice as easy to hit.

fields.name: lane
fields.tooltip: Ground = on the flight line. Air = GameSettings.airLaneHeight above it, where only a jump reaches — the future air lane, keep such entries at 0% until jumps ship them.
